places.name: Bold - Traditie & Inovatie
places.evidence: Vasile Bold is founder, administrator, and personally cooks the dishes; press and visitjurilovca.ro confirm his hands-on presence

places.name: Taverna La Navod
places.evidence: Founded ~2020 by Ioan-Lucian Fusaru (sole shareholder Risto Peste Pasta SRL), who trained as chef in Italy and returned to cook; visitjurilovca.ro and termene.ro profile confirm owner-chef role

places.name: Casa Ilinca - Punct Gastronomic Local
places.evidence: Hosts Ana and Laurențiu run the gastronomic point personally; multiple reviews (amfostacolo, fifistie.ro, turistulliber) describe them as present hosts who cook and welcome guests

places.name: Gospodaria Lipoveneasca (Ferma Lipovenesc)
places.evidence: Owner Paul Condrat is described as gazda (host) on turistinfo.ro and turistulliber.ro; traditional farm with gastronomic point he built and runs personally

places.name: Terasa Sailors
places.evidence: Claudiu Lazar identified as owner via firmadeaur.ro (Edera SRL, sole shareholder) and contact email; however limited review evidence of personal daily presence
